name: @lattice/example-caverns
description: CAVERNS — a gallery exhibit. The light field alone: darkness, torches, and pools that meet without a bright seam.
$comment: Five of nine, and this is the one exhibit whose subject is a single module of a single package — @lattice/draw's LightField. `sim` and `persist` are absent because a cave has no economy and nothing that outlives the tab. `audio` is absent and it is the loudest omission in the gallery: a cavern is the exhibit that most wants a drip and a room tone, and it is left out only because the gallery still has no shared answer for the gesture that unlocks an AudioContext — the same finding `island` and `city` filed. `input` and `loop` arrive through examples/_shared's bootstrap and are named here because they are what this runs on.
